patch_description: This crossover retains the current circuit’s effective RY feature mixing while adopting the inspiration circuit’s shallow multiscale CZ butterfly. All input mixers share one parameter, and all output RX rotations share another, reducing the ansatz to two distinct trainable parameters. The fixed distance-1, distance-2, and distance-4 connections provide full-qubit information propagation without increasing optimization complexity. This stronger parameter sharing should improve parameter efficiency, regularization, and convergence while preserving the robust global correlations associated with the best prior topology.
